Figure 2:Overview of InitFree-SfM.Starting from input images, we extract pairwise correspondences and monocular metric depth, followed by geometric consistency filtering (Secs.4.1and4.2). From random global initialization, dOSE jointly optimizes camera poses and 3D landmarks (Sec.3.2), followed by joint metric refinement incorporating depth and relative pose constraints to obtain the final 3D reconstruction (Sec.4.3).
Overall, our simple yet effective pipeline offers a new perspective on initialization-free BA, highlighting the central role of geometric constraints beyond surrogate objective optimization.

Figure 3:Dissecting initialization-free BA on ETH3D.We compare (a) traditional OSE-based pipelines, (b) OSE optimization onS​E​(3)SE(3)with reprojection refinement, (c) OSE optimization with our joint metric refinement, (d) joint metric refinement directly from random initialization, and (e) our complete dOSE-based pipeline. Geometrically constrained refinement yields substantial improvements, even without preceding OSE optimization, while dOSE achieves the best accuracy. All configurations use the same correspondences and are randomly initialized (see App.F). Bars report pose AUC@20∘20^{\circ}and mean optimization time per scene.

Figure 4:Runtime comparison on low-overlap ETH3D (left) and SMERF (right).Lower is better. InitFree-SfM offers a favorable accuracy-runtime trade-off, achieving competitive reconstruction accuracy at substantially lower computational cost than MP-SfM. All methods use LoMa; runtimes are averaged per subset.
Figure 5:Effect of calibration on ETH3D and LaMAR. Calibrated runs use dataset intrinsics; uncalibrated runs use MoGe-2 intrinsics for ours and native calibration estimation for GLOMAP.

Figure 6:Optimization–reconstruction gap for the original pOSE pipeline on Courtyard (top) and Delivery area (bottom), using 20 images per scene. Left: normalized OSE loss during VarPro.
Middle: final camera trajectories compared with the reference. Right: reconstructed landmarks and cameras. Despite decreasing surrogate losses, the final reconstructions remain inaccurate after reprojection refinement and metric upgrade, highlighting the need to reconsider how existing InitFree BA pipelines enforce metric consistency.
